summary: Add CI publish-acceptance gates: consumer-install smoke (npm pack → install tarball → `npx flume status` exits 0) + `attw --pack .` clean, per §4/§2 acceptance

edit.description: Add consumer-install smoke step + attw step; broadens §8 ci.yml enumeration to meet §4/§2 acceptance.

acceptance: CI green on PR with two new steps: tarball-install smoke (`npx flume status` exit 0 in a fresh consumer project) and `npx @arethetypeswrong/cli@latest --pack .` exit 0.
notes: Justified by §4 L106 (consumer-install smoke) + §2 L64/§4 L108 (attw); §8 owns ci.yml. Mechanics: `npm pack` does NOT run prepublishOnly — CI must `pnpm build` before pack/attw or dist/ is absent. Tarball name: `jwcjwc12-flume-0.1.0.tgz`. Smoke consumer chain.ts must import the installed pkg `@jwcjwc12/flume` (NOT `../src/` as examples/minimal-chain.ts does for dogfood); an inline fixture is fine — no committed file needed. attw via npx (not a dep); use `@latest` per §2.
